verdict.rationale: Secureframe is a SaaS compliance platform, so letting users opt out of product telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls for Secureframe's own users. The cited items are about API access, integrations, Trust Center content visibility, and the customer-facing shadow-IT detection feature, none of which addresses opting out of tracking.
